acceptanceCriteria: The owner accepts or amends the CCE-V0 intent and answers or defers its owner questions in a recorded decision.
The first slice is completed with its live discrimination evidence.
CCE-V0-003 and CCE-V0-010..014 are implemented with focused tests, including the corvint e2e shadow report over a synthetic frozen window.
One adopter shadow window of at least 30 merged changes is run under the frozen gate and its result, pass or fail, is recorded in docs/build-log; no hosted test is deleted or disabled by Corvint.
The CCE-V0 delivery status and traceability table reflect the retained evidence, with any NOT_RUN qualification kept visible.
body: Owner request 2026-10-17: Corvint should understand the anatomy of an E2E test as lego blocks (page objects, paths, inputs and outputs, results, outcomes, scripts), hold a revision-pinned catalog of them, and when code changes compile the E2E test that checks the change, generated on demand by a local agent or CI and then run. Owner direction the same day: augment-first; hosted blocks, generated scenarios, a shadow evaluation against the existing suite before any test is retired. Spec: docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md (CCE-V0, proposed). The first slice is V1-1665, which this ticket depends on.
title: Change-compiled E2E: reviewed blocks compile into change-specific scenarios, shadow-evaluated before any hosted test retires (CCE-V0 umbrella)
